page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut architectural frame (canopy with curtains) enclosing the title text in the centre-right; no running text, no margin notes. Title text reads top to bottom inside the frame.

main_text.l: habent) Pontificiorum cum Evangelicis, in causa Religionis, Conciliationem : cudendamque
Auth. Josepho Hallo Britanno, S.Th Doct. & Henrico Principi a Sacris.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving of a canopy/tent with curtains, clouds and hills, occupying the upper and left part of the page; not transcribed. Some words in the title are damaged or show-through from the reverse (e.g. "Conciliationem", "Pontificios" line 7–8 partly obscured, "hanc labam" reads as printed). Lines 7 and 8 contain words I could not fully confirm: "cat fa" in "in causa" is read as printed "cau-sa"; "labam" uncertain [?]. Show-through text from the reverse side appears faintly across the page and is omitted. Woodcut stains and a torn paper edge at the upper right are not transcribed.
